Ksaveriv Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zhytomyr Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This record contains a contradiction worth flagging: it is categorized as a demolished cemetery, yet the source's own demolished field marks it as 'no.' Ksaveriv had an organized Jewish community (kahal) as early as 1772, and its cemetery was also used by Jews from the nearby village of Skuraty. A local resident recalled the cemetery still existing around 1970; a 1995 survey by the Commission on the Preservation of Jewish Heritage found it already gone, suggesting its destruction took place sometime between the 1970s and 1990s.
